title: Composition-based machine learning for predicting and designing Mn4+-doped phosphors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,11415-11425
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00029K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ngo T. Que, Vu D. Huan, Le T. Duy, Vu N. Bao, Vu L. Minh, Mai X. Trang, Anh D. Phan, Pham T. Huy
We collect the largest experimental dataset and apply machine learning to study composition–property relations in Mn4+-doped phosphors. The resulting models outperform prior studies and show good agreement with experimental data.
